text: Kill switch stops every question at the first check; no plan, no tool.
Attempts to override the rules or reveal the key are stopped (injection).
Requests for personal data (SSN, passport, address, phone) are stopped (pii).
Instructions to send, approve, release, book, pay or change a limit are stopped (action).
source: README: When I call a calculation

text: Requests for legal advice are stopped (legal).
Questions not about this book are stopped (scope); questions naming a book counterparty are in scope.
Checks run in fixed order (kill, injection, pii, action, legal, scope); the first failure stops the rest, which are reported as not run.
Today's exposure / limit / breach / headroom questions route to current_exposure; 'limit' alone means today's exposure.
source: README: When I call a calculation

text: Future / potential future exposure / PFE questions route to check_pfe_limit and do not also run current_exposure.
source: README: When I call a calculation

text: Margin, threshold, minimum transfer, delivery/return questions route to calculate_margin_call; CSA wording questions also use it.
source: README: When I call a calculation

text: Spot or volatility of a named ticker routes to get_market_data with that ticker.
source: README: When I call a calculation

text: A haircut cell with no book name routes to regulatory_haircut with asset class, maturity and rating buckets.
source: README: When I call a calculation

text: A question asking several things yields several steps (at most 4), each with its own tool.
A follow-up uses the remembered counterparty only when it says it/its/their/them.
source: README: When I call a calculation

text: A missing required argument triggers a clarification question instead of a guess; the next turn resolves it.
Status uses the unrounded utilisation: > 100% BREACH, >= 85% WARNING, otherwise OK.
source: README: How I get a number, step 4

text: Today's exposure = max(gross mark - collateral after haircut, 0); mark = quantity x (price - entry).
source: README: How I get a number, steps 1-4

text: Collateral counts at face x (1 - haircut); cash 0%, Apex corporate >5y A+-BBB- 12%.
source: README: How I get a number, step 3

text: Credit support = max(0, gross mark + independent amount - threshold); delivery/return only if >= MTA, delivery rounded up, return rounded down to the rounding step; otherwise NO_ACTION.
source: README: How I get a number, steps 6-7

text: Any delivery or return is flagged for a person to review; nothing moves.
source: README: How I get a number, step 8

text: PFE engine passes its self-checks (closed form, collateral does not raise PFE, huge threshold disables collateral, netting, 1-day MPOR lowers collateralised peak).
PFE is deterministic for a fixed seed and path count.
The critic rejects wording whose figures, status or margin sentence are not in the tool result; one rewrite is allowed, then wording is dropped.
source: README: How a question runs, step 4

text: If the gateway fails or the model is off, keyword planning runs and no wording call is made.
source: README: How a question runs, step 2

text: Output is English/ASCII only; CJK characters are not allowed.
Busy/unavailable gateway responses are retried after 2, 4, then 8 seconds.
A question over 1,000 characters is rejected; empty input stops the console.
A tool failure over MCP is surfaced as a failed step, not a crash.
The API key is never logged.
A clarification is resolved by the user's next reply: the planned tool runs with the supplied value, memory is updated, and the pending question is cleared.
A reply that does not supply the missing value (unknown name, wrong kind of value, 'not sure') asks again instead of guessing or giving up.
source: README: ask, do not guess (agreed default)

text: If the user ignores a pending clarification and asks a new full question, the new question is answered as asked and the old pending question is dropped.
A refused turn (guardrail or kill switch) does not erase the remembered counterparty and does not cancel a pending clarification.
A new run starts with no remembered counterparty and no pending clarification.
source: README: 'The same process remembers the last name'; agreed default 3

text: Memory follows the conversation: naming a different counterparty replaces it; price and haircut questions leave it unchanged; pronouns resolve to the latest one.
source: README: When I call a calculation; app._remember
